Backend 6/6 pytest PASS: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/payment flips Nanti→Lunas + appends kind='payment:lunas' event, idempotent second call appends another payment:lunas event (2 total, still Lunas), 404 on unknown id for both GET and PATCH payment, default actor='kasir' works, PATCH /status regression still returns 200. (not a bug, expected per agent note). parseQrPayload logic verified via page.evaluate replica: 'LND-ABC123'→'LND-ABC123', {order_id:'LND-XYZ'}→'LND-XYZ', 'random-text'→null, ''→null — all correct. Production /production: WASH station click opens qr-scanner-modal with correct title 'Scan tag · WASH' + helper 'Sorot QR tag cucian di antrian Antrian' + graceful camera-error banner. Courier /courier JEMPUT: 'SCAN BARANG PICKUP' opens scanner with helper 'Sorot QR code pada bag jemputan pelanggan'. ANTAR tab: 'SCAN BARANG MASUK MOTOR' correctly disabled when readyOrders empty. Manifest list empty on fresh DB (iter-28 mock leak fix confirmed). Regression /tracking: 7 counter cards render live counts (Antrian=4 Selesai=1 after my test POSTs), search input present. Mark-taken (Packing→Selesai) and pay-now (Nanti→Lunas + kind='payment:lunas') flows verified end-to-end by driving underlying PATCH endpoints in browser context — status persists on GET.

ui_bugs.issue: Shadcn Dialog's built-in Close button (absolute top-4 right-4, rendered by @radix-ui via DialogContent) overlaps and intercepts pointer events on the custom [data-testid=qr-scanner-close] button at (top-3 right-3). Playwright cannot click qr-scanner-close because the built-in Close subtree covers it. Users on device tap the visible built-in Close which still closes fine, so functionally works but the custom testid button is unreachable. Fix: either remove the custom close and hide/style the built-in one, or use a Dialog variant without the auto-Close (e.g., pass `hideClose` or override the Close element).
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid="qr-scanner-close"] intercepted by DialogContent Close button (absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-sm)

ui_bugs.issue: A11y: `DialogContent requires a DialogTitle` console error on every scanner open (Production + POS + Courier). Component renders its title inside the body (line 139) but not inside a Radix DialogTitle element. Wrap the heading in <DialogTitle> (optionally inside VisuallyHidden if the custom layout must stay).

action_items: QrScanner.jsx: eliminate overlapping shadcn default DialogContent Close (or remove the custom qr-scanner-close) so testid is clickable and there's only one visible close affordance.
QrScanner.jsx: wrap the title text in <DialogTitle> (VisuallyHidden if needed) to silence a11y console errors.

Optional: end-to-end camera flow (real QR decode) can't be exercised in headless — main agent may want to add a hidden dev-only 'Paste decoded text' input inside QrScanner (guarded by NODE_ENV or query param) so future E2E tests can inject a decoded string without a physical camera.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.py mark_paid (line 146-174) correctly uses $set + $push atomically, appends OrderEvent with kind='payment:lunas', and is idempotent by design (unconditional $set to 'Lunas'). No 400/409 for already-lunas which matches the stated 'idempotent' spec — good.

QrScanner.jsx correctly requests facingMode {ideal:'environment'} and cleans up track on unmount via stop().finally(clear()) — no lingering camera lights. Debounce logic on identical repeats (300ms) is sensible.

ScanOrderDetailModal.jsx cleanly separates mark-taken vs pay-now flows with distinct busy state; toast messages are user-friendly. handlePaymentCapture uploads PoD first then patches payment — order matters: if the PATCH fails after upload, the photo is orphan but audit-recoverable via order_events (pod:payment event still stored on the order). Acceptable.
parseQrPayload (api.js line 82-94) — regex accepts any LND-... substring including partial junk after separator; consider anchoring or bounding to typical UUID-tail length. Low priority.
POSScreen.jsx now ~1291 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting scan-nota + customer-search + register flows into dedicated hooks.

Two low-priority UI polish items: (1) duplicate close buttons on QrScanner modal due to shadcn Dialog default Close overlapping custom qr-scanner-close, (2) A11y DialogTitle warning. Real QR decode path was not tested with an actual camera; recommend either (a) using Chromium --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream + --use-file-for-fake-video-capture with a QR PNG in future testing, or (b) adding a dev-only text-injection affordance to QrScanner.
rca of the issue: Overlapping close: shadcn/ui `DialogContent` (from `@/components/ui/dialog`) renders a built-in <DialogClose> as `absolute right-4 top-4`. QrScanner.jsx adds its own close at `absolute top-3 right-3`. Both are within the same DialogContent and the built-in one is rendered AFTER (higher stacking order), so it intercepts pointer events on the custom testid. Solution: remove the custom button and target the built-in Close via a role selector, OR use a shadcn Dialog variant that suppresses the default Close.
